content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect configuration of the pull control for the PMIC_IRQB and PMIC_KEYINB interrupt lines on the Exynos4210-based Origen board. These lines had external pull-up resistors, and the previous configuration did not disable the internal pull control, which interfered with the proper functioning of the MAX8997 interrupts. Disabling the pull control allowed the interrupts to operate correctly and enabled the wakeup functionality from the MAX8997 RTC alarm.
